name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strikes kill at least seven across six Ukrainian regions on 25 Nov; Ukraine hits three Russian refineries
state: Overnight to 25 Nov Russia launched 112 drones at Ukraine, killing at least seven people in six regions and hitting a Naftogaz gas facility in Poltava region and a DTEK power plant (Euronews). Two people were killed in Odesa region on 24 Nov, the governor said (Al Arabiya). Ukraine struck the Kuibyshev, Syzran and Novoshakhtinsk refineries; on 24 Nov Putin threatened retaliation. This follows the 19–20 Nov mass strike and a 24 Nov Zaporizhzhia attack that wounded 44, so the Alert holds.
for_you: Anyone in or travelling to Ukraine should follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel. Strikes on energy sites cause power cuts across several regions as winter sets in.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes (19–20 Nov mass strike; 7 killed across 6 regions on 25 Nov) = Alert
